tic-tac-toe.title: Tic-Tac-Toe
tic-tac-toe.tagline: The timeless game of grid strategy and tactical placement.
tic-tac-toe.description: Challenge yourself against a smart AI opponent or match up with players worldwide. Master corner control, force double-threat setups, and dominate the 3x3 grid.

rules.title: Grid Setup
rules.desc: The game is played on a 3x3 grid of nine square spots.

rules.title: Taking Turns
rules.desc: Player 1 places an X and Player 2 places an O in turn until all spots are filled or a player wins.

rules.title: Winning Condition
rules.desc: Connect 3 of your marks horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to secure victory.

rules.title: Draw Condition
rules.desc: If all 9 squares are filled and neither player has 3 marks in a row, the match ends in a draw.

tips: Occupy the center square early to maximize potential line connections.
Control two opposing corners to force your opponent into defense mode.
Create a double-threat (fork) where you have two ways to win on your next turn.

reviews.comment: Classic game executed flawlessly! The AI difficulty levels provide a solid challenge.
Online multiplayer works super fast with zero latency. Love the clean UI!
Great casual game to test quick strategic thinking during breaks.

memorycards.title: Memory Cards
memorycards.tagline: Test your focus and short-term visual memory matching pairs.
memorycards.description: Flip and match matching pairs of cards in as few moves and fastest time as possible. Train concentration and pattern recognition skills.

rules.title: Grid Lay Out
rules.desc: Cards are shuffled face-down across a rectangular grid.

rules.title: Flip Two Cards
rules.desc: Select two cards to reveal their hidden symbols.

rules.title: Match or Reset
rules.desc: If symbols match, cards remain face-up. If not, both cards flip back down.

rules.title: Clear the Board
rules.desc: Match all card pairs in minimum total moves to maximize your high score.

tips: Mentally divide grid into 2x2 quadrants to remember positions easier.
Take your time on early flips to memorize board layouts.

reviews.comment: Super addicting! Great quick mental exercise before starting work.
The smooth card animations and timers make competing on the leaderboard really fun.
